correct_answer: Seat de do kyunki yeh basic courtesy hai

hinglish_question: Ek village mein bijli 8 ghante aati hai - subah 6 baje se 10 baje aur shaam 5 baje se 9 baje. Farmer ko pump chalana hai 3 ghante ke liye. Kab chalaye?
